title: install.json
description: The install record at .rbtv/config/install.json: what the rbtv installer installed in one target folder. Written and read only by the installer.

schema.description: The version of this record's format.

marker.description: The per-unit generated-file ownership marker, `rbtv-managed`. Shared files use booked keys or fenced sections; guidance copies use a generated banner. The install record tracks installed units and files.

guidance_basis.description: The folder instructions file the author writes: CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

guidance_excludes.description: Paths the installer does not walk when it writes folder instructions copies.

guidance_files.description: Folder instructions copies the installer generated.

components.description: Each installed component, keyed by its id.

tree.description: Where the component came from: `repo` for a component shipped in the rbtv repository, or `mirror` for a local component.

harnesses.description: The harnesses this component was installed for.

units.description: Each installed skill, rule, command, agent, hook, MCP server, tool, or folder-instructions file of the component, keyed by its name.

method.description: How it is installed: its exposure method, `tool` for a tool placed on PATH, or `folder-instructions` for a component's marked section.

files.description: The files the installer wrote for it.

claims.description: Keys or fenced sections it owns inside files shared with other components, such as a hook's entry in a harness settings file or a rule's section in root AGENTS.md.

links.description: Commands the installer placed on PATH for it.

shared_files.description: Files shared by components through booked keys or fenced sections.

shared_claims.description: Which component owns each booked key or fenced section inside a shared file, as path::key.

path_links.description: Links the installer placed on PATH for tools.

agent_units.description: In an installed agent's folder only: the units its agent file selected at the last install or update, as <module>/<component>#<unit>. An update removes only the units that left this list; units installed by other means, such as Ignite's standard units, stay.
